e.title: Gen Re 精算 GenAI 框架
e.summary: Gen Re（再保巨头）：精算智能 × 生成式 AI 框架（以重疾理赔为例）
e.body:
Gen Re（全球再保险公司）「Actuarial Intelligence with Generative AI – A Framework Illustrated Through Critical Illness Claims」：精算智能 × GenAI 的应用框架——以重疾（CI）理赔为例的框架展示。对 RIAA：再保人的精算 GenAI 框架——与 [[actuarygpt]]（精算 LLM 案例）、[[claims-intake-agent]]（理赔受理）配套：再保场景的 GenAI 应用框架；理解「精算智能 + GenAI」在理赔（CI）的落地；再保方向（[[rim530]]）的 GenAI 参考；精算 AI 应用的行业框架。

## 同类工具
[[intact-ai-leadership]]、[[peak3-ai-insurance-guide]]、[[aws-audit-manager-insurance-chatbot]]

e.summary_en: Gen Re (global reinsurer): actuarial intelligence with generative AI — a framework illustrated through critical-illness claims
e.summary_hk: Gen Re（再保巨頭）：精算智能 × 生成式 AI 框架（以重疾理賠為例）
e.body_en:
Gen Re (the global reinsurer) 'Actuarial Intelligence with Generative AI – A Framework Illustrated Through Critical Illness Claims': a framework of actuarial intelligence × GenAI — illustrated through critical-illness (CI) claims. For RIAA: a reinsurer's actuarial-GenAI framework — with [[actuarygpt]] (actuarial-LLM cases) and [[claims-intake-agent]] (claims intake) it frames GenAI application in reinsurance scenarios; understand the landing of 'actuarial intelligence + GenAI' in claims (CI); a GenAI reference for the reinsurance direction ([[rim530]]); an industry framework of actuarial-AI applications.
